claim: A tractor turn assistance system comprising a tractor controller, a continuously variable transmission controller, an implement controller, an operator terminal, vehicle-position sensors, and a forward optical row-end sensor.

The system of claim 1, wherein the transmission controller receives an engine-load estimate and adjusts a transmission ratio to keep travel response within a selected operating band during work and during a turn.

The system of claim 1, wherein the controller enables a stored headland turn sequence only when the vehicle position is within a configured approach region and the optical sensor confirms row termination for a configured number of observations.
The system of claim 1, wherein the controller requests operator confirmation or deferral if the optical sensor is obscured or if observations disagree.
A tractor controller that adjusts the transmission ratio based on measured engine load.
A draft-control system raises a hitch by a limited increment when draft exceeds a threshold.
A central tire system selects a field or road pressure setting and adjusts the tire toward it.
